scope: One official Tencent public Space; read-only sources and metadata requests. No generation, GPU allocation, key retrieval, or checkpoint download.

free_access.official_documentation: Existing ZeroGPU Spaces are free to all users, subject to account-tier daily GPU quotas and queues.
free_access.specific_gpu_model: Runtime API returns hardware code zero-a10g; physical GPU model was not independently observed.

source_geometry.input_mode: Single image; model name does not select MV_MODE. Four multiview controls exist but are hidden and ignored in this default mode.
source_geometry.sampling: App forwards steps, guidance, deterministic torch.Generator seed, octree resolution and chunk count to Hunyuan3DDiTFlowMatchingPipeline.
source_geometry.output: Shape-only function exports untextured white_mesh.glb and returns file update, viewer HTML, mesh statistics, seed. No cleanup or face reduction is applied on this shape-only path.
source_geometry.quality_mode_controls: Options tab is hidden. Turbo/Fast/Standard callback sets steps to 5/10/30 only; no model switch. High decoding maps to resolution 384.
source_geometry.model_selection_basis: Source launch defaults plus live hidden MultiView/Options tabs. Actual returned mesh stats are required to confirm model identity after a future generation.

source_dtypes.app_override: App supplies device but does not override dtype or variant.
source_dtypes.scheduler: Uniform sigmas from 0 to 1; classifier-free guidance is conditioned on model guidance embedding support.

official_model_facts.reported_evaluation: README reports higher image-condition metrics than listed baselines; this is not a character-specific result or comparison against current 2mv Turbo.

api.live_schema_status: Root fetched public GET metadata successfully; read locally.
api.caption: Gradio State excluded from public API arguments.
api.texture_endpoint: /generation_all is separate; source GPU duration 180 seconds. Not called.
